about_the_game:
"Night Drone" is a game about using drones in modern warfare. To achieve your goals, you will have to control various types of drones (reconnaissance drone, kamikaze FPV drone, FPV drone, drop drone, supply drone and other types of flying drones). You will have to show the skills of controlling FPV drones, ingenuity, tactics, strategy to find targets, break through anti-aircraft installations and hit the desired enemy targets.

Game Features:

-There are several different types of thrones, each with its own characteristics and the purposes for which they are used (FPV kamikaze drone, FPV drone, surveillance/fusion drone, drop drone, mavic, supply drone and others).

-Various types of terrain (plains, highlands, landings, woodlands, settlements, military bases, military airports, trenches, dugouts, destroyed cities, etc.).

-Different types of targets and enemies: artillery, anti-aircraft guns, tanks, infantry, trucks, planes and others.

-Simple controls for beginners.

-First-person view (from the drone operator's camera).
